verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at platform.claude.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing the Anthropic developer documentation. The cited doc pages are themselves served as plain .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed at both an index and markdown docs. The intro.md.md 404 only reflects a malformed double-extension probe and does not undercut this. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at any probed path, no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-corpus file, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
